title: Instrument Usage Agreement Schedule of Checkout and Care Conditions, Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program
content:
This schedule to the instrument usage agreement of the Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program sets out, for each usage type, the conditions attached to a checkout and to the care of the instrument while the student holds it.

## Conditions at checkout

| Usage type | Ensemble director must approve the checkout | Parent signs the instrument usage agreement before checkout | How instruments are assigned | Condition recorded at checkout | Most open checkouts a student may hold at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | yes | yes | director assignment by ensemble need | yes | 1 |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | yes | yes | director assignment by ensemble need | yes | 1 |
| Brass Instrument Usage | yes | yes | director assignment by ensemble need | yes | 1 |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | yes | yes | director assignment by ensemble need | yes | 1 |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | yes | yes | director assignment by ensemble need | yes | 1 |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | yes | yes | director assignment by ensemble need | yes | 1 |

## Care of the instrument and condition reporting

| Usage type | Instrument always carried in its district case | May be used in marching season | Condition grades used on condition reports | How damage at return is judged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | yes | yes | excellent, good, fair, needs repair | compared with the checkout condition report |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | yes | yes | excellent, good, fair, needs repair | compared with the checkout condition report |
| Brass Instrument Usage | yes | yes | excellent, good, fair, needs repair | compared with the checkout condition report |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | yes | no | excellent, good, fair, needs repair | compared with the checkout condition report |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | yes | yes | excellent, good, fair, needs repair | compared with the checkout condition report |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | yes | yes | excellent, good, fair, needs repair | compared with the checkout condition report |

## Notes to the schedule

- The conditions are uniform across the six usage types except marching-season use: an instrument held under Orchestra String Instrument Usage may not be used in marching season, while an instrument held under any of the other five usage types may.
- The most open checkouts a student may hold at once is 1 under every usage type. The figure is per student, not per household.
- A condition report grades the instrument with one of four grades only: excellent, good, fair or needs repair.
- Under every usage type the instrument is always carried in its district case.

Hypothetical illustration: a violin checked out under Orchestra String Instrument Usage and graded good at checkout is, under this schedule, an instrument the director approved and assigned, whose agreement the parent signed, which travels in its district case and which is not used in marching season; its condition at return is judged against the good grade recorded at checkout.
